title: Gaia DR3 nearby, bright, quality-filtered neighbourhood
frame: ICRS-aligned Gaia-CRF3 direction; no epoch propagation
origin: Sun; published geometric distances are heliocentric

source.catalogue: Gaia DR3 gaia_source; DR3 retains the EDR3 astrometry and source list
source.archivePartner: ARI (Astronomisches Rechen-Institut, Heidelberg), Gaia Archive partner TAP mirror
source.distanceMethod: Bailer-Jones et al. (2021) geometric posterior median with 16th and 84th percentile bounds
source.attribution: Gaia data: European Space Agency mission Gaia, processed by DPAC. Distances: Bailer-Jones et al. (2021). Accessed through the ARI Gaia Archive partner.

selection.ordering: parallax descending, exact Gaia source ID ascending for ties
selection.completeness: The largest-parallax 384 rows meeting these filters inside the 20 pc parallax gate. Brightness, quality, and row-limit selections prevent a complete-census interpretation.

query:
SELECT TOP 384 g.source_id AS gaia_source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.ref_epoch, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.parallax_over_error, g.pmra, g.pmra_error, g.pmdec, g.pmdec_error, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.ruwe, g.astrometric_params_solved, g.visibility_periods_used, g.ipd_frac_multi_peak, g.astrometric_sigma5d_max, d.r_med_geo, d.r_lo_geo, d.r_hi_geo
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g
JOIN gaiaedr3_complements.distances AS d ON d.source_id = g.source_id
WHERE g.parallax >= 50.0
AND g.parallax_over_error >= 20.0
AND g.ruwe <= 1.4
AND g.visibility_periods_used >= 10
AND g.astrometric_params_solved = 31
AND g.phot_g_mean_mag <= 12.0
AND g.bp_rp IS NOT NULL
AND g.pmra IS NOT NULL
AND g.pmdec IS NOT NULL
AND d.r_med_geo > 0
AND d.r_lo_geo > 0
AND d.r_hi_geo >= d.r_med_geo
AND d.r_med_geo >= d.r_lo_geo
ORDER BY parallax DESC, gaia_source_id ASC
transformations: Gaia source IDs remain decimal strings and are never converted to JavaScript numbers.
Displayed distance is the published r_med_geo geometric posterior median, not 1000/parallax; r_lo_geo and r_hi_geo remain attached as the 16th–84th percentile interval.
Unit direction uses ICRS-aligned J2016.0 RA/Dec: x=cos(dec)cos(ra), y=sin(dec), z=cos(dec)sin(ra).
Display radius is 5 + 13*log10(distancePc + 1) scene units. This logarithmic transform is visual compression, not a physical coordinate.
BP-RP colour drives the disclosed display colour ramp; G magnitude is retained for selection and inspection. Point glyphs are not resolved stellar images.
No proper-motion propagation, parallax zero-point correction, live claim, or missing-distance fallback is applied.
